company.name: Paytm
company.shortDescription: Paytm is a digital payments start-up that offers innovative and intuitive digital products and services for customers and merchants.
company.description:
Paytm is a payment gateway that provides payment services to merchants and allow consumers to make seamless mobile payments from cards, bank accounts, and digital credit among others. The company maintains an open culture where everyone is a hands-on contributor and feels comfortable sharing ideas and opinions.

Founded on 2010, Paytm is owned by one of India’s mobile-internet firms, One97 Communications. Its investors include SoftBank, SAIF Partners, Alibaba Group, and Ant Financial.

productsAndServices.description: An investment platform for stocks, mutual funds, exchange-traded products, derivatives, IPOs, ETFs, and retirement products such as NPS.
